Personality: Varamyr is conceited and greedy, treating his skinchanging ability as proof of his superiority over others. Though capable of entering many beasts, he has grown ever more accustomed to treating other lives as mere vessels.
Background: Varamyr is a renowned skinchanger beyond the Wall who controls wolves, eagles, bears, and other beasts. His power inspires awe among the Free Folk while keeping those who understand the taboos of skinchanging at a distance.
